title: N87 Shaders
description: A realistic shaders for Minecraft, with a modern and cutting-edge look.
body:
N87 Shaders is a shader pack for modern versions of Minecraft that adds support for physics-based rendering, realistic and caustic water, god rays, realistic sun and moon, and good Nether rendering. Work in progress.

Based on ARC Shaders (open source, MIT license), all credits to Null-MC for the original version. License: https://github.com/Null-MC/Arc-Shader/blob/main/LICENSE
